sources: dossier=sensor (Required behaviors: sensor-http body-hash line, artifact-tier, internally incoherent with 'one message per tick'); code=lib/services/sensors/sensor-http/sensor.go pollOne (skips emission when cur.LastHash==hash); test=sensor-http's own e2e proof asserting exactly-one message over 5 identical 200 polls
note: The dossier's 'one message per tick' phrase is an uncorroborated artifact-tier fragment that is internally incoherent with the same sentence's body-hash persistence (persisting a hash only serves change-dedup); the sensor's own delivered code and its designated proof both converge on emit-on-body-change. Reworded the story's Role/Capability/Acceptance/Falsifier to state dedup-on-unchanged-body semantics, matching code and proof.

sources: dossier=sensor (Required behaviors: 'watermark advances before the POST — at-most-once', corroborated across 2026-05-15 and 2026-06-08 artifacts); code=lib/services/sensors/sensor-object-store/sensor.go (watermark advance/persist at :351-372 precedes postMessage at :388)
note: The dossier explicitly and deliberately labels this at-most-once, not exactly-once: the watermark-first ordering is the intended design, not a bug, because it exists to guarantee restarts never re-send. The story's acceptance overclaimed 'exactly one message'; reworded to at-most-once send semantics with watermark-advance-before-send made explicit, matching the dossier and leaving the code untouched.

sources: dossier=sensor (Required behaviors: 'sensor-webhook acknowledges an inbound POST only after rimsky has persisted the translated message', corroborated across 2026-05-17 and 2026-06-08 artifacts); doc=sensor-webhook.md acceptance/falsifier already state this correctly; code=lib/services/sensors/sensor-webhook/sensor.go (idempotency key recorded at :186/:192 before postMessage at :220, so a retry after a failed delivery short-circuits at :181-184 returning 200 with no message ever persisted)
note: Story prose is correct and matches the dossier's ack-after-persist invariant; the code violates it on the retry-after-failed-delivery path. This is a code defect, queued for Phase 2 (not touched here). The proof gap (no test exercises idempotency/failure) is a secondary symptom of the same root cause and is covered by the same fix-code queue entry.
